sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Fourteen selected parameters including assumed carbonization prefactor and activation energy sampled in declared ranges. Permeability fixed at 3.75e-14 m2; oxygen kinetic reference and inlet atmosphere fixed. These small paired ensembles do not prove all-parameter, permeability-range or oxygen-poor robustness. Previous ensembles belong to their historical model versions.
